title: Junior Payroll Assistant
description:
Through proprietary software and AI, along with a focus on customer delight, Sleek makes the back-office easy for micro SMEs.

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

We operate across 3 business segments:

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Mission of the role

To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines.

The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation.

Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency

Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls.

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing

Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness

Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement

Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience.
  • Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage.
  • Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes.
  • Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics.
  • Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows.

Must-have attributes

Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks.

Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required.

Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements.

Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients.

Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship.

AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and workstreams. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing, inconsistent, or likely to cause an issue.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess spoken and written communication, relevant UK payroll experience, motivation, and initial background.

Technical Round: A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines.

Soft Skills Round: A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations.

Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Some other great things about working at Sleekâ¦

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.Â 

Flexibility: Youâll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we donât mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: Youâll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so youâll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. Thereâs also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. Weâre also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Â Since we started our journey in 2017, weâve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, weâve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

    Â 

Outcome

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

Location

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

Interview Process

Our studio operates as a remote-first workplace, offering flexible work arrangements.

 

PLEASE NOTE: At this time, we are only able to hire candidates who are legally eligible to work in Canada and reside within Canada.


Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

You'll work closely with systems design, combat design, art, narrative, audio, and engineering to create spaces that complement the game's core combat systems while providing strong pacing, readability, and a sense of discovery. The role involves collaborating with leadership to align content with the overall creative vision while owning levels end-to-end, from initial layout and blockout through implementation, iteration, and polish. As a senior designer, you'll be expected to independently solve complex level design problems, provide strong design judgment, and help establish a high quality bar for playable content across the game.

\n


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with combat, systems, narrative, art, engineering, audio, and production to create levels that support the established creative vision and core gameplay pillars

  • Own levels end-to-end, including layouts, blockouts, combat spaces, encounters, traversal, exploration, pacing, and player flow

  • Design engaging combat spaces that support varied enemies, character builds, abilities, positioning, and different approaches to combat

  • Create rewarding exploration through optional paths, secrets, environmental storytelling, and meaningful rewards while maintaining clear navigation and progression

  • Script and implement gameplay events, encounters, objectives, triggers, and environmental interactions directly in engine

  • Test, debug, and iterate on levels using playtest feedback to improve combat flow, difficulty, pacing, readability, and replayability


Requirements

  • A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

  • Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

  • Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

  • Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

  • Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

  • Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities


Pluses

  • Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

  • Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

  • Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

  • Appreciation for systemic combat and how level geometry, enemy composition, hazards, and interactive elements combine to create varied encounters

  • Experience designing dungeons, interconnected environments, procedural or modular level content, or other repeatable gameplay spaces

  • Strong instincts for environmental storytelling, gameplay readability, polish, and identifying opportunities to improve the player experience through iteration

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

This job description is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with the job of the incumbent. title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.

You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.

  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

title: Sales Development Representative - All levels (f,m,x)
description:
Wir suchen eine:n SDR für unser Growth Team an unserem Standort in Berlin oder Hamburg. Werde Teil unseres Teams und baue mit uns das größte KI-gestützte FinTech für das Gesundheitswesen auf!

Das Level für diese Rolle legen wir gemeinsam im Prozess fest – abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und wie du im Interview überzeugst.

 

Über Nelly

Wir bauen das AI-Driven Financial Operating System für das europäische Gesundheitswesen und lösen so die größten Herausforderungen für Patient:innen und Praxen. Damit schaffen wir, was keine Bank oder Softwareplattform bewältigen kann. Unsere All-In-One Plattform verwandelt chaotische administrative Prozesse in intelligente, automatisierte Arbeitsabläufe, von der Patientenbetreuung über die Abrechnung bis hin zu Zahlungen der nächsten Generation. Denn wir sind davon überzeugt: Das Gesundheitswesen sollte weniger mit Papierkram und mehr mit Menschen zu tun haben.

Warum? Europa ist mit einem massiven Mangel an medizinischen Fachkräften konfrontiert. Wenn wir die Arbeitsweise von Praxen nicht überdenken, wird das System nicht mithalten können. Mit unserer Series B Finanzierung in Höhe von über 50 Millionen Euro von Weltklasse-Investoren setzen wir unsere Vision in die Tat um.

Was dich erwartet: Wir arbeiten mit dem besten Team und geben gemeinsam jeden Tag alles. Wir setzen auf Talent Density, weil außergewöhnliche Menschen alle um sie herum besser machen. Bei Nelly bewegen wir uns schnell und erwarten, dass alle mithalten. Stillstand ist keine Option, deshalb investieren wir stark in Weiterentwicklung. KI ist bei uns kein Nice-to-have. Wir erwarten, dass du sie täglich nutzt und geben dir alle Möglichkeiten, dies zu tun. Du bekommst Vertrauen und Verantwortung, dafür erwarten wir, dass du Dinge ansprichst, auch wenn es unbequem ist.

Deine Rolle bei uns:

Du bist die erste Stimme, die potenzielle Nelly-Kund:innen von uns hören – und die Person, die entscheidet, welche Leads es bis zur Demo schaffen. Konkret heißt das:

  • Du baust dir deine eigene Pipeline auf: von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme bis zum gebuchten Demo-Termin, komplett eigenverantwortlich.

  • Du sprichst täglich mit ca. 60 potenziellen Kund:innen – am Telefon, per Cold Call und im Inbound-Gespräch – und entscheidest selbst, wie du sie überzeugst.

  • Du qualifizierst Leads sauber und ordnest sie korrekt bestehenden Accounts zu, damit im Vertriebsteam niemand bei null anfängt.

  • Du gibst Marketing direktes Feedback zur Lead-Qualität – deine Beobachtungen fließen sofort in die nächste Kampagne ein.

  • Du bist Teil von Messen und Events und bekommst dadurch Einblick, wie Nelly bei echten Kund:innen ankommt – nicht nur am Telefon.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Partnerships und Marketing zusammen und siehst, wie dein Beitrag den gesamten Sales-Zyklus verkürzt

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du hast Hunter-Mentalität und Can-do-Attitude – Telefonieren und Überzeugen ist für dich kein notwendiges Übel, sondern macht dir Spaß.

  • Du übernimmst Ownership über deine eigene Pipeline, ohne dass dir jemand hinterherlaufen muss.

  • Du bist stressresistent und KPI-getrieben – Zahlen motivieren dich, sie schüchtern dich nicht ein.

  • Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf C2-Niveau

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn:

  • Du lieber in Ruhe an einer Sache feilst, statt täglich viele Calls zu führen und dich an klaren Zahlen messen zu lassen.

  • Dich Ablehnung am Telefon frustriert statt anzuspornen – Cold Calling gehört zum Alltag, nicht zur Ausnahme.

  • Du einen klar vorgezeichneten, unveränderlichen Prozess erwartest – der Inbound/Outbound-Split verschiebt sich je nach Lead-Lage, und du musst dich flexibel darauf einstellen.


Unser Interviewprozess:

  • First Call mit deiner TA Partnerin (online, 30 Minuten)

  • Second Call mit deinem potenziellen Team Lead (online, ca. 45 Minuten)

  • On Site Gespräch, ca 60 Minuten

Was wir bieten:

  • BVG-Ticket oder Swapfiets-Mitgliedschaft, damit du schnell unterwegs bist

  • Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft, damit Bewegung und Ausgleich nicht zu kurz kommen

  • 500€ L&D Budget, um dich weiterzuentwickeln

  • 28 Urlaubstage, steigend, bis 30 Tage erreicht sind

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und ein Hybrid-Setup

  • Bis zu 4 Wochen Workation

  • Ein hundefreundliches Büro mit guter Atmosphäre und einem Team mit dem es Spaß macht zu arbeiten

  • Snacks und ein Kühlschrank voller kalter Getränke

Wir leben Vielfalt und freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter (m/w/d). Und weil wir wissen, dass Selbstzweifel oder das sogenannte Impostor-Syndrom oft davon abhalten, sich zu bewerben, gilt: Zögere nicht, auch wenn du nicht jedes einzelne Kriterium erfüllst. Wenn du überzeugt bist, dass du gut zu uns passt, sag uns warum – wir freuen uns ehrlich darauf, von dir zu hören.

title: Engineering Manager - Cloud Platform & Operations  (f/m/d)
description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

  • SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

  • SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

  • SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

  • Committed to our customers and community.

  • Obsessed with quality.

  • Deliberate in our decisions.

  • Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description
 
As a member of one of our engineering teams, you'll be a key player in making SonarQube Cloud and SonarQube Server the best tools for Code Quality and Security, providing new features to deliver high-quality and powerful products and services that help our users write better software.
 
You will have the opportunity to see your features come to life in Production with short iteration loops. While keeping our roadmap and business priorities in mind, you will be able to have a high impact on the software that we own and develop.
 
By joining us you will bring your experience and expertise to help push our product to its next stage of evolution and fulfill the needs of our large user and customer base.

What you will do
  • Lead and manage a team of Engineers (Cloud Engineers and Site Reliability Engineers), providing guidance, support, and mentorship to help individuals grow in autonomy and master the complexities of cloud operations.
  • Hold yourself and your team accountable to high engineering standards, specifically focusing on system reliability, performance, and security.
  • Manage the team’s operational workload, including on-call health, incident response, and the reduction of manual toil through automation.
  • Foster a safe culture of feedback and continuous improvement, encouraging the team to conduct blameless post-mortems and share architectural insights.
  • Collaborate with other  value stream squads to ensure the production platform meets the needs of our developers while maintaining strict governance.
  • Communicate a clear vision for the squad that aligns with the platform engineering roadmap, focusing on resiliency, business continuity, and cost optimization.
  • Partner with the Hiring team to recruit talented Engineers for the team. Participate in improving the hiring process for the team and ensuring we recruit enough to reach our goals.
  • Lead by example, modeling behaviors of servant leadership and high-stakes decision-making.

    • Experience and qualifications
  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a significant focus on Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Operations, or Infrastructure Engineering.
  • Operational Mindset: Deep understanding of the DevOps/SRE mindset, including experience managing mission-critical shared services (e.g., Aurora DBs, OpenSearch, Control Planes).
  • Cloud Expertise: Advanced knowledge of AWS (or similar providers) and experience managing organizational-scale infrastructure (IAM, OUs, Account Vending).
  • Infrastructure as Code: Experience with the coding lifecycle in an infrastructure context (e.g., Python, CDK, Terraform) and the ability to perform rigorous code reviews for infrastructure components.
  • Observability & Resiliency: Proven experience defining observability patterns (logging, tracing, metrics) and designing Disaster Recovery/Business Continuity strategies.
  • Agile & FinOps: Experience with Agile methodologies and a strong understanding of cloud cost optimization (Rightsizing, Spot instances, Reserved Instances).

    • Additional comments
    This role is based in Bochum, Germany. We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Bochum, but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

    Benefits
  • Pension Scheme: 1st Pillar (Unterstützungskasse): Automatic, financed by Sonar, 3% of gross salary, an additional benefit in addition to your salary.
  • Pension Scheme:2nd Pillar (bAV): Voluntary, 15% contribution by Sonar from social security savings.
  • We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations with 28 PTO days for our employees based out of the Geneva region, plus additional days based on seniority and circumstances.
  • Sonar recognizes holidays on working calendar days. If the holiday date occurs on a Saturday, we will recognize the day on the preceding Friday. If the holiday date occurs on a Sunday, we will recognize the day on the following Monday.
  • Public transport reimbursement of 60% for annual subscription.
  • Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually.  
  • Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (B2B SaaS Startup)
description:
Our Mission

Join us in reshaping global trade in a fast-growing startup!

We are traide AI – a VC-backed, B2B deep tech startup based in Berlin, using AI to solve one of the most overlooked yet critical challenges in international trade: customs compliance. Our software automates product classification, reduces regulatory errors, and helps customers save up to 83% of their time.

Trusted by leading brands like Siemens Healthineers, Koro, and Jack Wolfskin, we've achieved 2x growth over the past 12 months – and we're just getting started.


Your tasks

At traide AI, we believe customs specialists deserve smarter, faster workflows and the future of global trade depends on it. As a Senior Backend Engineer, you'll play a pivotal role in builing robust, AI-powered backend services and infrastructure that drives the value creation for our customers. Your main expertise lies in backend technology but you should not be afraid to contribute to other parts of the application.

You'll join a tight-knit, VC-backed B2B startup - calm but ambitious - where your ideas shape both product and culture.

Product Development

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of new features and improvements in our web application across the whole stack: shaping everything from technical design to production release
  • Write both client-side and server-side code within our well-established codebases
  • Analyse and communicate trade-offs in technical designs in RFC style discussions, drive decisions for your projects
  • Be the backend expert in rotating project teams, give feedback on the contribution of other team members within your area of expertise

Cross-functional collaboration

  • Work alongside designers to shape user flows, evaluate feasibility, and improve interfaces and user experience
  • Partner with AI engineers to bring cutting-edge research and prototypes into production-ready features
  • Contribute your perspective to product discussions, helping set direction with both technical and user impact in mind
Code quality & technical excellence

  • Set and uphold high standards for code quality, architecture, and best practices within the team

  • Design and maintain robust automated tests to ensure reliability and quality at scale

  • Develop and improve instructions, guardrails and feedback mechanisms for coding agents

  • Select and configure tooling that improves developer experience and keeps our CI/CD pipeline efficient

  • Proactively identify and solve technical challenges before they become blockers

Knowledge sharing

  • Share your expertise through code reviews, mentoring, and documentation — helping others level up and ensuring our knowledge grows as the team grows


Who we’re looking for

You're an experienced engineer who cares deeply about craft, but even more about impact. You love clear thinking over hype, and you're energized by the idea of turning AI research into products people actually use every day.

  • 7+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, ideally building complex products in dynamic environments
  • Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science or a related discipline
  • Deep proficiency in TypeScript, including advanced type-level programming
  • Familiarity with synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns, HTTP APIs (REST and GraphQL), event-driven architecture, and common design patterns.
  • Solid database skills across both relational and non-relational databases such as Postgres and Redis or similar.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud, and the services that typically come with them.
  • You embrace AI tools in your workflow and are driven to master emerging technologies
  • You champion code quality and drive best practices across the team
  • You thrive in fast-moving environments - seeking opportunities to learn, grow, and both give and receive feedback
  • Strong English skills (C1 or better); German is a plus but not required
  • Curiosity about adjacent fields like DevOps, Security, Frontend development, AI Engineering etc.
Our Tech Stack:
  • React & Chakra UI (Component library)
  • GraphQL
  • Node.js & Prisma (ORM)
  • Python & FastAPI & SQLAlchemy
  • Postgres for storage & Redis for caching & messages
  • Terraform / Open Tofu orchestrating Google Cloud Platform


Why us?

  • Varied day-to-day: Every feature comes with unique technical challenges → no two days are the same
  • Visible impact: You'll see the direct results of your work → for both our customers and traide AI
  • Direct impact on product: Your technical decisions shape what we ship and how it performs
  • Team culture: You'll be part of a team that communicates transparently, values humor, and supports each other with respect and sincerity
  • Flexible working: We enjoy working together in our office at Senefelder Platz in Berlin Prenzlauer Berg/Mitte. Home office is also an option for two days per week
  • Be part of our regular team events (boot trips, bowling etc.)
  • Enjoy benefits like an Urban Sports Club membership

title: IT-Spezialist:in Software- & Platform-Engineering (m/w/d)
description:
Die Albert Schweitzer Stiftung für unsere Mitwelt sucht

IT-Spezialist:in Software- & Platform-Engineering (m/w/d)

zum nächstmöglichen Termin in Berlin (hoher Homeoffice-Anteil möglich) mit 35 Wochenstunden (Vollzeit) in Festanstellung.


Unsere Vision ist eine Welt, in der kein Tier mehr für die Herstellung von Lebensmitteln leidet. Unsere Mission lautet: Gemeinsam Tierschutzstandards erhöhen und den Verbrauch von Tierprodukten senken. Mit unserer Arbeit wirken wir in den Bereichen Wirtschaft, Recht und Politik. Auf allen Ebenen gehen wir mit den jeweiligen Akteur:innen praktikable Schritte in Richtung eines respektvollen Umgangs mit den Tieren und erleichtern auch vermeintlichen Gegner:innen den Ausstieg aus bisherigen Handlungsmustern.


Als IT-Spezialist:in Software- & Platform-Engineering wirst du Teil unseres bislang zweiköpfigen IT-Teams, das mit einem reibungslosen, effizienten und sicheren Betrieb von IT-Infrastruktur und Online-Auftritten dafür sorgt, dass unsere Arbeit ihre maximale Wirkung entfalten kann.  


Das bewirkst du bei uns

Du legst das technische Fundament, auf dem die gesamte Arbeit der Albert Schweitzer Stiftung für unsere Mitwelt aufbaut, und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme zuverlässig, sicher und zukunftsfähig bleiben.

Als IT-Spezialist:in Software- & Platform-Engineering bist du verantwortlich für die Konzeption, Planung und Umsetzung der Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Infrastruktur und -Anwendungslandschaft: Du betreust unsere Hosting-Infrastruktur in der Cloud und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter, sorgst dafür, dass zentrale Systeme wie CRM, Spendenplattform, Webseiten, Kampagnen und Mailing-Infrastruktur reibungslos miteinander Daten austauschen, und entwickelst dafür auch individuelle Softwarelösungen.


Im Einzelnen bedeutet das

  • Du betreust, entwickelst und integrierst sowohl unsere bestehenden als auch neu einzuführende IT-Systeme, wie auch unsere DevOps-Plattform, zum Beispiel GitHub und AWS, weiter. 

  • Du konzipierst, implementierst, dokumentierst und rollst neue IT-Projekte & Lösungen aus.

  • Du stehst im engen Austausch mit Kolleg:innen im IT-Team und in anderen Fachbereichen und berätst zu fachlichen wie nicht-fachlichen Anforderungen, etwa IT-Sicherheit oder Usability.

  • Du unterstützt und berätst die Fachbereiche bei der Konzeption und Implementierung von IT-Lösungen – von der Einschätzung technischer Machbarkeit und Aufwand über die technische Umsetzung bis hin zur Auswahl geeigneter Off-the-Shelf-Komponenten.


Dein Profil

  • Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung sowie im Betrieb moderner Anwendungs- und Plattform-Infrastrukturen (z. B. Cloud/PaaS, CI/CD, Integrationen).

  • Im Bereich DevOps und IT-Infrastruktur bringst du herausragende Erfahrung mit.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwareentwicklung (vorzugsweise PHP/Laravel) und der Integration von Anwendungen per REST oder GraphQL APIs

  • Für die Entwicklung von Web-Anwendungen beherrschst du HTML, (S)CSS und Javascript/Typescript und hast auch Erfahrung in der Anpassung von PHP-basierten CMS-Systemen wie Kirby und Statamic.

  • Du bist in der Lage, ein IT-Projekt von Anfang bis Ende zu planen, durchzuführen und zu Ende zu bringen.

  • Dabei arbeitest du zusammen mit fachlichen Stakeholdern, von der Anforderungsanalyse über iterative Checkpoints bis zum Rollout .

  • Du nutzt KI-Systeme, um deine eigene Arbeit zu unterstützen, und kannst anderen dabei helfen, KI für ihre Ziele sinnvoll einzusetzen.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Automatisierung von Arbeitsabläufen sind gefragt, mit KI-Tooling, Low-Code/No-Code-Plattformen oder klassisch per Scripting. 

  • Du hast gute Kenntnisse in IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz.

  • Du kennst dich aus im Bereich Identitätsmanagement (IAM) per OAuth oder SAML.

  • Du bist team- und kommunikationsfähig und arbeitest serviceorientiert sowie selbständig.

  • Mit deiner herausragenden Problemlösungskompetenz gehst du auch komplexe technische Herausforderungen sicher an.

  • Auch wenn es mal stressig wird, weil z. B. eine Deadline näher rückt, bleibst du konzentriert.

  • Deutsch und Englisch sprichst du verhandlungssicher (C1-Niveau).

  • Du arbeitest gerne mit anderen zusammen – auch wenn nicht alle an einem Ort sind.

  • Du identifizierst dich mit unserer Vision, Mission und Kultur.


Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine unbefristete Vollzeit-Stelle auf 35-Basis: Als Teil des IT-Teams bewirkst du direkt gesellschaftliche Veränderungen und verbesserst den Tierschutz.

  • Home-Office-Möglichkeiten: Du wohnst in Berlin oder Umgebung und arbeitest mit flexiblen, familienfreundlichen Arbeitszeiten im hybriden Modell (Homeoffice & Büro).

  • Professionelles Team: Kollegialer, offener Austausch in einem motivierten Team 

  • Hundefreundliche Büros inkl. „hundefreie“ Bereiche für Allergiker:innen sowie ergonomische Arbeitsplätze

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Unbefristet, Jahresgehalt zwischen 48.940,20 und 59.243,40 Euro (erfahrungsbasiert) + Bonuszahlungen 

  • Benefits: Cafeteria-Modell (finanzielle Vorteile, Deutschlandticket oder zusätzliche Urlaubstage), Zuschüsse zu Gesundheitsleistungen (z. B. B12 + D Bluttests) und betriebliche Altersvorsorge

  • Weiterbildung: Aktive Förderung von Fort- und Weiterbildungen


Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt?

Dann schick uns deine Bewerbung bis zum 31.10.2026 per Bewerbungsbutton. Wir möchten von dir erfahren, was dich motiviert, bei der Albert Schweitzer Stiftung zu arbeiten, weshalb du die beste Person für diese Rolle bist und wann du bei uns anfangen könntest. 


Solltest du nicht alle Kriterien erfüllen, ermutigen wir dich trotzdem, dich zu bewerben - wir sind auf der Suche nach einer lernfähigen und motivierten Person, die in unser Team passt.

Wir sind überzeugt, dass vielfältige Perspektiven Entscheidungen verbessern können und begrüßen daher ausdrücklich Bewerbungen von Menschen verschiedener Hintergründe.


Bei Fragen zu der Stelle melde dich gerne bei Marie Mittermeier an .

building tomorrow. Das treibt uns an. empact baut den dezentralen Energieversorger für den Gebäudesektor und bereitet damit den Weg in eine klimaneutrale und lebenswerte Zukunft. Für dieses Vorhaben suchen wir engagierte Persönlichkeiten, die gemeinsam mit uns an der Schnittstelle zwischen Energie und Gebäude etwas verändern wollen und bereit sind, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst eigenverantwortlich Energiekonzepte und Machbarkeitsstudien für nachhaltige Wärme- und Energieversorgungslösungen in den frühen Projektphasen (HOAI-Leistungsphasen 1–2)
  • Du legst Wärmepumpen, Wärmequellen, Speicher, Energiezentralen sowie Wärme- und Kältenetze technisch aus und bewertest unterschiedliche Versorgungskonzepte
  • Du analysierst und vergleichst Systemvarianten hinsichtlich technischer Machbarkeit, Wirtschaftlichkeit und langfristiger Umsetzbarkeit
  • Du erstellst technische Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Kostenschätzungen, Anlagenbeschreibungen und hydraulische Schemata für unsere Projekte
  • Du berücksichtigst Fördermöglichkeiten wie BEW und BEG sowie relevante Normen und regulatorische Anforderungen bei der Konzeptentwicklung
  • Du arbeitest eng mit den Teams aus Projektentwicklung, Fachplanung und Projektrealisierung sowie externen Planungspartnern zusammen
  • Perspektivisch übernimmst Du weitere Planungsleistungen in den HOAI-Leistungsphasen 3–4 und bringst Deine Konzepte bis zur Entwurfs- und Genehmigungsplanung voran


Dein Profil

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Energie-, Versorgungs-, Gebäude-, Umwelt- oder Verfahrenstechnik oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
  • Du verfügst über mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Konzeption, Planung oder Auslegung von Wärme- und Energiesystemen
  • Du hast bereits eigenständig Wärmepumpenprojekte konzipiert und bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in der Wärme-, Kälte- und Anlagentechnik mit
  • Du kennst die HOAI-Leistungsphasen 1–2 sehr gut und hast idealerweise bereits Erfahrung in den Leistungsphasen 3–4 gesammelt
  • Du verstehst wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und kannst technische Konzepte auch unter Kosten- und Fördergesichtspunkten bewerten
  • Du bringst Erfahrung in der technischen Auslegung, Simulation oder Planung von Energiesystemen mit
  • Du verfügst über ein gutes Verständnis hydraulischer Systeme sowie der Schnittstellen zu TGA, MSR, Elektrotechnik und Bau
  • Idealerweise hast Du bereits mit Simulations- und Planungstools wie EnergyPRO, Polysun oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen gearbeitet
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, denkst lösungsorientiert und hast Freude daran, technische Konzepte eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben
  • Du möchtest die Wärmewende aktiv mitgestalten und nachhaltige Energieprojekte von der ersten Idee bis zur umsetzbaren Lösung entwickeln


Warum empact?

  • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung, wie sie zu Dir passt: Bestimme selbst, wo Du am besten arbeitest – remote, unterwegs oder von einem unserer Standorte. Plane Deine Arbeitszeit nach Projekterfordernissen und gestaltest Deinen Arbeitstag so, dass er optimal zu Dir und Deinen Aufgaben passt.
  • Perfekte Lage an unseren Standorten: Ob in Köln direkt am Dom, in Berlin am Südkreuz oder in München an der Isar – unsere Büros bieten Dir eine gut angebundene und attraktive Arbeitsumgebung.
  • Verantwortung mit echtem Impact: Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für Deine Projekte, triffst eigenständig Entscheidungen und gestaltest Abläufe und Prozesse aktiv mit.
  • Gezielte Weiterentwicklung: Wir fördern Deine Entwicklung – mit individuellen Weiterbildungen, Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen Spezialisierung und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.
  • Teamwork, das verbindet: Auch wenn Du remote arbeitest, bist Du Teil eines starken Teams. Regelmäßige Teamtreffen, Projekt-Reviews und standortübergreifender Austausch sorgen dafür, dass Wissen geteilt wird.
  • Sicherheit & spannende Projekte: Unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis, 30 Tage Urlaub und abwechslungsreiche Projekte, bei denen Dein Beitrag sichtbar Wirkung zeigt.

title: Werkstudent:in AI & Business Automation (m/w/ d)
description:
Über uns – Talentspring Academy Group

Was passiert, wenn Millionen Menschen nicht mehr mithalten können – während die Arbeitswelt längst weiterzieht?

Über 6 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland haben keinen anerkannten Berufsabschluss. Gleichzeitig verändern Künstliche Intelligenz, Automatisierung und digitale Geschäftsmodelle ganze Branchen schneller, als das Bildungssystem reagieren kann. Der Fachkräftemangel ist längst strukturell – und mit ihm wächst die Dringlichkeit, Menschen gezielt und wirksam neu zu qualifizieren.

Genau hier setzt die Talentspring Academy Group an. Wir qualifizieren Menschen für die Arbeitswelt von morgen: digital, förderfähig und praxisnah. Unsere Weiterbildungen in KI, Marketing, Sales, HR und Future of Work orientieren sich an dem, was der Arbeitsmarkt tatsächlich braucht – für Menschen ohne Abschluss, Quereinsteiger:innen, Arbeitssuchende und Beschäftigte, die sich weiterentwickeln wollen.

Dabei verbinden wir die Agilität eines EdTechs mit der Reichweite etablierter Bildungsakteure: AI-first Lerntechnologie auf der einen Seite, über 900 Standorte durch strategische Partnerschaften im Bildungssektor auf der anderen. Das gibt uns eine bundesweite Infrastruktur, Vertrauen im Bildungssystem und direkten Zugang zu unseren Zielgruppen – digital, lokal und menschennah.

Über 100 Teammitglieder arbeiten jeden Tag daran, dass aus einer Förderzusage ein tatsächlicher beruflicher Neustart wird. Unser Ziel: Menschen befähigen, Unternehmen entlasten und Bildung als Standortstrategie neu denken – für eine Wirtschaft, die niemanden zurücklässt.


Über die Rolle

Als Werkstudent AI & Business Automation (m/w/d) arbeitest Du an der Schnittstelle von Business Building, künstlicher Intelligenz und operativer Umsetzung.

Gemeinsam mit unserem Venture- und Leadership-Team identifizierst Du Prozesse und Geschäftsbereiche, in denen AI und Automatisierung einen echten Unterschied machen können – und setzt die passenden Lösungen direkt mit um. Dabei geht es nicht um theoretische Konzepte oder reine Analysen: Du baust Workflows, testest Tools, strukturierst Daten und entwickelst Lösungen, die tatsächlich im Arbeitsalltag eingesetzt werden.

Du bekommst früh viel Verantwortung und arbeitest an Themen aus unterschiedlichen Bereichen – von Operations und Sales über Finance bis hin zu neuen Geschäftsmodellen. Die Rolle passt zu Dir, wenn Du Technologie nicht nur spannend findest, sondern sie aktiv einsetzen möchtest, um reale Business-Probleme zu lösen.


Deine Aufgaben

AI & Automation

  • Du identifizierst Prozesse mit Automatisierungspotenzial und entwickelst dafür konkrete Lösungen.
  • Du baust und optimierst AI-gestützte Workflows, Automationen und interne Tools, beispielsweise mit n8n, Make, APIs oder modernen AI-Tools.
  • Du testest neue AI-Anwendungen und bewertest, wie sie sinnvoll in unsere bestehenden Prozesse integriert werden können.
  • Du begleitest Lösungen von der ersten Idee über den Test bis zum produktiven Einsatz.
Business Building & Prozesse
  • Du analysierst bestehende Geschäftsprozesse und identifizierst Schwachstellen, manuelle Arbeitsschritte und Skalierungspotenziale.
  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team neue Prozesse und digitale Lösungen.
  • Du unterstützt bei Business-Building-Projekten und hilfst dabei, neue Ideen schnell zu validieren und umzusetzen.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Teams zusammen und übersetzt operative Herausforderungen in konkrete Lösungsansätze.
Data & Reporting
  • Du arbeitest mit Daten aus unterschiedlichen Systemen und hilfst dabei, relevante Kennzahlen transparent und nutzbar zu machen.
  • Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und bei der Weiterentwicklung von Reports und Dashboards.
  • Du analysierst Daten und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für operative und strategische Fragestellungen ab.
  • Du achtest darauf, dass Daten und Kennzahlen nachvollziehbar und belastbar sind.
Research & neue Technologien
  • Du beobachtest neue Entwicklungen rund um AI, Automation und digitale Geschäftsmodelle.
  • Du testest neue Tools und Technologien und bewertest deren Nutzen für Talentspring.
  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und hast die Möglichkeit, neue Ansätze schnell in der Praxis auszuprobieren.


Das bringst Du mit

  • Studium & Verfügbarkeit: Du bist aktuell immatrikuliert, beispielsweise in BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Entrepreneurship, Data Science oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang, und kannst uns ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche unterstützen.
  • AI-Native Mindset: Du nutzt AI-Tools selbstverständlich in Deinem Alltag und hast Lust, Dich tief in neue Technologien und Anwendungen einzuarbeiten.
  • Hands-on Mentalität: Du möchtest nicht nur analysieren oder Präsentationen erstellen, sondern Dinge selbst bauen, ausprobieren und verbessern.
  • Technisches Verständnis: Du hast bereits erste Erfahrung mit Automatisierungstools, APIs, AI-Workflows oder Coding gesammelt – beispielsweise mit n8n, Make, Zapier, Python, JavaScript oder vergleichbaren Tools.
  • Businessverständnis: Du kannst Dich schnell in Geschäftsprozesse hineindenken und verstehst, dass eine technische Lösung nur dann gut ist, wenn sie ein echtes Problem löst.
  • Analytische Stärke: Du arbeitest strukturiert mit Daten, Kennzahlen und komplexen Fragestellungen und hinterfragst Ergebnisse kritisch.
  • Ownership: Du arbeitest selbstständig, bringst Themen aktiv voran und wartest nicht darauf, dass Dir jeder nächste Schritt vorgegeben wird.
  • Deutsch: Du kommunizierst mündlich und schriftlich sicher auf C2-Niveau, da die Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung mit unseren internen Teams überwiegend auf Deutsch stattfindet.
  • Englisch: Du kannst Dich sicher mit englischsprachigen Tools, Dokumentationen und technischen Ressourcen bewegen.


Was wir Dir bieten

  • AI nicht nur in der Theorie: Du entwickelst Lösungen, die direkt im Unternehmen eingesetzt werden.
  • Echter Business Impact: Deine Arbeit beeinflusst unmittelbar, wie effizient und skalierbar unsere Teams arbeiten.
  • Viel Verantwortung: Du bekommst eigene Themen und Projekte statt klassischer Werkstudent.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Venture- und Leadership-Team zusammen.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Du bekommst Einblick in AI, Automation, Operations und Business Building gleichzeitig.
  • Flexibilität neben dem Studium: Die Rolle ist auf ca. 20 Stunden pro Woche ausgelegt und lässt sich mit Deinem Studium verbinden.
  • Berlin & Teamnähe: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Team in Berlin zusammen und bekommst direkten Einblick in ein wachsendes EdTech-Unternehmen.


Unser Bekenntnis zur Chancengleichheit

Wir bei Talentspring sind stolz auf die Vielfältigkeit unseres Teams. Weder bei der Einstellung noch während des Beschäftigungsverhältnisses werden Entscheidungen auf Basis von Hautfarbe, Religion oder religiösen Glaubens, ethnischer oder nationaler Herkunft, Nationalität, Geschlechtsidentität, sexuelle Orientierung, Behinderung oder Alter getroffen. Talentspring steht für einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz und geht gegen Diskriminierung und Belästigung jeglicher Art vor. Uns ist es besonders wichtig, das jede:r sich zu seinem/ihrem vollsten Potential entwickelt und in keinster Weise Benachteiligung erfährt. Wir sind stolz auf unser diverses Team und stellen sicher, dass wir in jeder Besetzung diese gelebte Diversität auch erfüllen.

As a working student in Customer Success, you help our customers get real value out of Userlane in two ways. Informationssicherheit entscheidet heute darüber, ob ein Unternehmen handlungsfähig bleibt. Unsere Kunden sind Mittelständler und KRITIS-Organisationen, die NIS2 und steigende Anforderungen nicht als Formular sehen wollen, sondern als Schutz, der trägt.

Als Andockoffizier bist du die Person, bei der aus Interesse eine Entscheidung wird. Du führst Strategiegespräche mit Geschäftsführung und IT-Leitung, schaffst Entscheidungssicherheit und bringst die Beauftragung über die Ziellinie. Andocken heißt: zwei Seiten verbinden sich fest. Genau das ist deine Aufgabe.

Du verkaufst nicht, was ein Hersteller vorgibt. Du verkaufst, was unsere Crew wirklich umsetzt, und du kannst es auch in einem Jahr noch vertreten.

Was dich erwartet

Deine Rolle an Bord

Du übernimmst vorqualifizierte Bedarfe. Erstkontakt und Terminierung liegen bei einer Agentur oder einem anderen Crew-Mitglied, das Mehrwertgespräch führt unsere Fachseite. Wenn ein Gespräch bei dir ankommt, ist der Bedarf geprüft. Deine Aufgabe beginnt dort, wo es um die Entscheidung geht.

Strategiegespräche führen

  • Problem-, Ziel- und Nutzenbild gemeinsam mit dem Kunden schärfen

  • Entscheidungsweg, Kriterien und Beteiligte offenlegen

  • Jedes Gespräch mit bestätigtem Ergebnis und verbindlichen nächsten Schritten beenden

Abschluss steuern

  • Angebote strukturieren, Optionen klar darstellen, Einwände und Risiken offen adressieren

  • Beauftragung abschließen, Kick-off vereinbaren und die Übergabe an die Umsetzung sicherstellen

Vom Einstieg zum Mandat

  • Du schließt unsere Einstiegsprodukte ab, z. B. ISO 27001-Bestandsaufnahme, NIS2-Startpaket oder CRA-Startpaket

  • Daraus entwickelst du Folgeaufträge über Mandate und Services, z. B. ISO 27001-Einführung oder NIS2-Umsetzung mit ISB-Mandat, Kryptoinventar- & SBOM-as-a-Service

Fachliche Rückendeckung

  • Bei der Lösungsarchitektur sitzt die Fachseite mit am Tisch. Du musst Technik nicht allein verkaufen

  • Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung, ohne Freigabeweg über mehrere Ebenen

Woran du gemessen wirst

Abschlussquote, Angebotsdurchlaufzeit, Auftragseingang und Genauigkeit deiner Prognose. Nicht an der Zahl deiner Anrufe.

So sieht deine Woche aus

  • Unser Zielbild bei aufgebauter Pipeline: bis zu 10 vorqualifizierte Strategiegespräche pro Woche

  • Ein fester Wochentermin mit der Geschäftsführung zu Pipeline und Risiken

  • Abstimmung mit der Fachseite vor Gesprächen mit Lösungsbezug

  • Monatsreview zu den Vertriebskennzahlen

Was du wissen solltest

Wir sind eine kleine Crew. Du bist die erste Besetzung im Abschluss, ein Vertriebsteam gibt es nicht. Du startest aber nicht bei null: Marke, Produkte, Website, Leadgenerierung, CRM und Angebotsvorlagen stehen bereits. Auf dieser Basis bauen wir die Pipeline weiter aus. Ein durchgehend gefüllter Kalender ist zum Start noch nicht zu erwarten.

Dein Fixgehalt gibt dir dabei eine verlässliche Basis. Deine variable Vergütung entsteht aus dem provisionsfähigen Ertrag deiner abgeschlossenen Aufträge. Du passt zu uns, wenn du Verantwortung übernehmen und unseren Vertrieb auf einer bestehenden Grundlage weiterentwickeln möchtest.

  • Vertrauensarbeitszeit mit Zeiterfassung

  • Mentoring und Patenschaft im Onboarding

  • Moderne Ausstattung, für alle gleich

Klingt nach deiner Mission?
