About the Position

HOLY is growing fast: with new product launches, expanding retail partnerships, and an ever-increasing customer base driving demand across all channels.

To keep pace with this momentum, we are looking for a Logistics Manager with a clear focus on Retail and a strong connection to D2C Logistics. You will make sure that retail orders are prepared completely and delivered on time, while also supporting reliable D2C fulfillment, inventory flow, and customer experience.

This role is highly operational and hands-on. You are the kind of person who spots a problem, takes ownership, and fixes it before it becomes a bigger issue.

Retail Logistics Ownership

  • Take end-to-end responsibility for ensuring that retail orders are complete and ready for shipment on time.
  • Own Retail OTIF performance and proactively steer against deviations with fulfillment partners and retail customers.
  • Coordinate display assembly, capacity planning, timelines, and escalations.

D2C Logistics Support
  • Support reliable D2C order fulfillment, inventory flow, replenishment, and delivery performance.
  • Monitor open operational issues and coordinate quick resolutions with fulfillment partners, Supply Chain, Customer Service, and E-Commerce.
  • Support accurate system synchronization across warehouses and sales channels.

3PL Partnership & Operations Oversight
  • Act as an operational contact for our fulfillment partners across Retail and D2C topics.
  • Ensure SLA adherence and daily operational stability.
  • Escalate and resolve deviations in speed, accuracy, availability, or cost efficiency swiftly.

Performance Analysis & Reporting
  • Track retail and D2C logistics KPIs and turn them into actionable insights.
  • Use partner reports and internal dashboards to identify risks, recurring issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Maintain clear SOPs, documentation, and performance reporting for internal visibility.
Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Act as the communication bridge between Logistics, Inside Sales, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service, Supply Chain, and external partners.
  • Keep stakeholders informed of critical operational updates, risks, and changes.
  • Lead root-cause investigations and coordinate quick resolutions to protect customer experience.
Process Improvement & Scalability
  • Improve recurring logistics workflows across Retail and D2C.
  • Identify efficiency and cost-reduction opportunities and track implementation progress.
  • Help build scalable logistics playbooks for HOLY's omnichannel growth.


About You

  • Retail-Ops-Ownership: You take full end-to-end responsibility for retail order readiness and OTIF performance, proactively steering against deviations before they become escalations.
  • 3PL & partner management: Proven experience managing fulfillment partners operationally - holding them to SLAs, resolving deviations in speed, accuracy or cost quickly and calmly.
  • Cross-functional coordination: Comfortable acting as the bridge between Logistics, Retail, E-Commerce, Customer Service and Supply Chain, keeping stakeholders aligned even when things move fast.
  • Analytical & KPI-driven: Skilled at turning partner reports and internal dashboards into actionable insights, spotting risks and recurring issues early.
  • Language proficiency: Fluency in English and German is a must.


Our Offering

In today's job market, A-players have many options to choose from. As part of our offer, we prioritise providing a productive working environment and opportunities for growth. In addition to competitive compensation, including company shares, you can expect:

  • A successful and growing company: Join a company that has been growing profitable and quickly for the last 36+ months and have just raised a series B, while many other e-commerce companies are struggling.
  • Huge impact: Enjoy huge impact to shape HOLY’s internationalisation in a top market.
  • Awesome team: Join an awesome team of colleagues who are ambitious, funny, down-to-earth, and authentic. Get to know us and see for yourself!
  • Top product: Marketing is important, but a good product is essential. Our differentiated soft drinks have won over customers. Check out our reviews.io reviews or contact us for free samples.
  • Startup culture: Join a startup culture that values flat hierarchies, fast pace, and personal development. With us, you can make a real impact.
  • Perfect setup: Enjoy a perfect setup that includes all the requirements of a modern employer, such as a central office in Berlin Prenzlauerberg, flexible working hours, and much more.
  • Competitive comp. + equity: Join us at a pivotal stage of hypergrowth. We offer a strong salary and meaningful equity—giving you the chance to share in our current success and benefit from the massive upside as we scale.
Find out more about HOLY and our team on our careers page.


The Process

As we are experiencing rapid growth and have ambitious plans, the optimal start date for the position is today. Nonetheless, we are prepared to patiently await the arrival of the ideal candidate, recognizing that quality ultimately yields the best results.

  1. Getting to know you: After reviewing your CV, Eric, our Talent Acquisition Manager, will have a 30-minute screening interview with you to discuss more about HOLY and the position and see if our expectations match.

Car Finance at Marshmallow

Marshmallow is opening up access to credit to migrants, bringing a brand new product to market which provides newcomers to the UK with fairly priced car finance for the first time.

Our Car Finance team is building a new generation lending platform from the ground up, making it simple, transparent and accessible for people who need finance to get on the road. We work closely with dealers, brokers and customers to make sure that every application, decision and interaction is fast, fair and easy to understand.

Because we’re a small, high-performing team, everyone has real ownership. We combine hands-on operations with a strong focus on automation and technology. We’re designing highly automated, AI-powered processes that let us move faster and smarter than traditional lenders.

The Role

We're hiring a Data Scientist to sit at the heart of how we lend: who we say yes to, at what price, and how we know it's working.

Our customers are people that traditional lenders struggle to assess. Many are new to the UK, have thin or no credit files, and don't fit neatly into off-the-shelf bureau scores. That makes credit decisioning at Marshmallow a genuinely hard, genuinely interesting problem: we combine bureau data, Open Banking, insurance, application and behavioural data to build a view of risk that others can't, and we need to do it in a way that is fair, explainable and compliant.

This role sits between a traditional credit analyst and a data scientist. You'll build and monitor scorecards, design and test credit strategies, dig into portfolio performance to find out what's really going on, and turn large, messy datasets into insights that change how we lend. You'll own your work end-to-end: from framing the question and pulling the data through to modelling, presenting a recommendation and seeing it live in our decision engine.

You'll be working with a small team and a modern stack, alongside a Head of Credit who has built this function from scratch and who will give you real ownership from day one. This is not a role where you hand models over a wall and move on - you'll see the impact of your decisions immediately.

  • Build, validate and monitor application and behavioural scorecards, using bureau, Open Banking and internal data to improve how we assess new-to-UK and thin-file customers.

  • Design, test and refine our credit strategy: cut-offs, affordability rules, pricing tiers and limits, with a clear view of the trade-off between risk, volume and margin.

  • Run experiments and champion/challenge tests to prove that changes to policy and models actually work before we scale them.

  • Explore new data sources and alternative signals, and build the case for using (or not using) them in decisioning.

  • Support model governance: document what you build, evidence that it treats customers fairly, and help us meet our Consumer Duty, CONC and model risk obligations.

  • Work with our engineers to get models and rules into production, and use AI tooling to make yourself and the team faster.

What You'll Bring

  • Hands-on experience developing or materially refining credit scorecards or risk models (logistic regression and/or gradient boosting), including the practicalities: sample design, binning, reject inference, validation and monitoring.

  • Experience working with Open Banking or other alternative data in credit decisioning.

  • Commercial judgement: you can translate a model output into a lending decision and explain the trade-offs to a non-technical audience.

  • Experience of working within a rapidly scaling lending environment.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.


You as part of tonies:

We're looking for an experienced Graphic/Visual Designer to own the design output of the tonies Accessories portfolio. Reporting to the Director of Accessories, you'll be responsible for CMF direction across all categories, 2D asset creation, product renders, licensor approval submissions, and Style Guide stewardship. You'll work within a structured product development process (PDP), holding the Responsible role across various design tasks — from initial ideation through to golden sample approval.

This is a role for someone who thinks in finished products that excite our target audiences, not just finished files. You understand that what you're designing will be held by a child, sitting on a shelf in a retailer in Germany, the US, or the UK, next to one of the most loved children's brands in the world. That context matters to you.


This role may NOT be a great fit if:
  • Your background is primarily in UI/UX, Web, or Digital Product Design.
  • Your experience is strictly in Hardlines or Industrial Hardware Design (e.g., plastic toys, consumer electronics, or pure hardware).   
  • You have no experience designing physical products aimed at kids, families, or youth lifestyle audiences.   
  • Your focus has been on managing external creative agencies or vendor design teams, rather than personally creating hands-on 2D production-ready artwork.


Your tasks and responsibilities will include:

Design ownership across the full PDP

  • Direct CMF (Color, Material, Finish) for all accessories categories — Headphones, Nightlights, Bags, Shelves, Decoration, and more.
  • Build design briefs for ODM/OEM manufacturing partners and own the construction sample process
  • Lead first sample and golden sample approvals against brand and CMF standards
  • Manage Top of Production (TOP) sample reviews and sign-off
  • Commission 3D packaging renders from supply partners and review against brand
Licensor management
  • Own the end-to-end licensor design submission process for all IP partnerships
  • Maintain the licensor submission tracker and ensure approvals stay on schedule
  • Build fluency with individual licensor style guides and maintain their application across the range
Brand stewardship
  • Own and maintain the Accessories Style Guides — the definitive brand reference for all categories
  • Ensure visual coherence across all accessories SKUs (across our entry, mid and premium tiers) in the annual pipeline with a distinctive connection with the broader tonies product ecosystem
  • Maintain and organise shared drive documentation (samples, approvals, asset files, product catalogue)
  • Work closely with external agencies and the brand creative teams to ensure alignment and brand integrity 
Cross-functional collaboration
  • Present design routes and options to Senior Product Managers who set commercial direction
  • Work in lockstep with the Senior Operations Lead on sample logistics, scheduling, and PDP coordination
  • Translate commercial briefs into executable design direction for manufacturing partners including our preferred outsourced operations partner. 


What we are looking for:

  • 5–7 years of product design, graphic/visual design or packaging design experience in consumer goods, accessories, lifestyle, or licensed products essential
  • Proven CMF direction experience across multiple product categories
  • Hands-on experience managing licensor approval loops with brand partners (entertainment, character, lifestyle IP)
  • Experience working with ODM/OEM supply chains — you know what a design brief needs to include for a manufacturer to execute it
  • Familiarity with a structured product development process (stage-gate, RACI-based, or similar)
  • Advanced Adobe Creative Suite proficiency (Illustrator, Photoshop) including production-ready artwork
  • Strong understanding of material and print processes — what a spec sheet needs to say, and why
  • English at a professional level; German is a strong plus
  • You must be able to work hybrid from one of our offices: Dusseldorf, Berlin, Schwäbisch Gmünd or London.

Nice to have:
  • 3D rendering capability (Keyshot, Rhino, or similar)
  • Experience designing within licensed brand style guides (entertainment IP, or similar)
  • Background in apparel, fashion & home accessories, or soft goods design (toys & consumer electronics is a plus)
  • Understanding of sustainable packaging and materials principles
  • Portfolio that demonstrates physical product development, not just graphic design


Why tonies?

●   Global Teamwork: We collaborate across departmental and country borders. You’ll be part of a truly international community where every voice is heard.
●   Come as you are: This applies to the dress code and everything else. We believe you give your best when you feel truly comfortable being yourself.
●   Competitive Package: We offer a competitive salary and a range of comprehensive benefits tailored to your specific location, which we’ll share during the recruiting process.
●   Collaboration & Community: We’re big on "we." You’ll join a team that values connection and celebrates wins together, no matter the time zone.
●   Continuous Learning: Benefit from internal/external training and an individual learning budget to keep your skills as sharp as a Tonie’s ears.
●   Tonie Discounts: Enjoy attractive discounts on our entire range of products. You’ll quickly become the favorite guest at every birthday party!
●   Rest & Recharge: Great work requires a clear head. You’ll enjoy generous paid time off to ensure you have plenty of time for your own stories.

title: Senior SEO Specialist
description:
About Legend


At Legend, we're building next-level player experiences. With 20+ years of proven success we’re the world's leading Sports and Gaming marketing company.

Our people are our edge. 600+ sharp, ambitious Legends across 22+ countries who move fast, learn quickly and win together. Here growth isn’t a perk, it’s the standard. You’ll stretch, level-up and carve out a career as bold as the products we build. We celebrate wins and create experiences that people talk about for years - for our players & for each other. If you’re ready to shape the future of player experience and enjoy the ride while you do it, this is where you’ll thrive.


The Role

Legend is hiring a Senior SEO Specialist, reporting directly to our Head of SEO.

This isn’t a traditional SEO role focused on optimising pages one by one. You’ll take ownership of SEO performance across key markets and complex initiatives, but you’ll also have the opportunity to zoom out, work with large datasets and help shape how we approach SEO at scale.

We’re investing in a more data-led, strategic and AI-enabled way of working, and you’ll play a key role in driving that forward. You’ll identify opportunities to use AI and automation, challenge existing processes and develop scalable solutions that can deliver meaningful impact across the wider SEO team.

You’ll have existing roadmaps, best practices and early AI experimentation to build from, but the autonomy to shape longer-term priorities and challenge how things are done. Whether you’re analysing the impact of changes across thousands of URLs, identifying strategic opportunities across markets or developing automated QA workflows, you’ll be expected to connect the dots, influence decisions and drive improvements across our portfolio.

We’re looking for an experienced SEO who combines strong analytical thinking with strategic judgement, thrives on solving complex problems and is excited by what AI and automation could unlock. You don’t need to be an AI expert. What matters is that you’re already exploring its potential, can identify where it will add real value and have the confidence to turn ideas into scalable improvements.

In this role, we value diverse perspectives and encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification listed.


Your Impact:
  • Own and drive SEO performance across key markets or complex initiatives, shaping longer-term roadmaps, identifying growth opportunities and ensuring priorities align with wider business objectives.
  • Turn complex datasets and competitor insights into strategic action, identifying patterns, anticipating challenges and influencing SEO priorities across markets and teams.
  • Drive the adoption of AI and automation within SEO workflows, identifying high-impact opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability and quality.
  • Design, test and implement scalable automation workflows that improve how the wider SEO team operates, including opportunities to transform areas such as SEO QA.
  • Lead analysis of wider changes across our portfolio, translating findings into clear strategic recommendations and influencing cross-functional teams to deliver measurable improvements.
  • Help shape the future of SEO at Legend, challenging existing processes, driving continuous improvement and sharing your expertise to help others adopt smarter, more scalable ways of working.

    • What You'll Bring:
  • Deep SEO expertise, particularly across on-page optimisation, with strong technical SEO knowledge and experience developing strategies that deliver measurable improvements across large, complex websites.
  • Advanced analytical skills, with experience working with complex datasets, identifying trends and translating insights into strategic recommendations that influence longer-term priorities.
  • A proactive approach to AI and automation, with experience identifying opportunities, experimenting with solutions and improving workflows to deliver greater efficiency and scalability.
  • A proven ability to independently own complex SEO initiatives, prioritise opportunities based on impact and effort, and deliver measurable outcomes while navigating cross-functional dependencies.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex analysis, challenge assumptions and influence decisions across teams through evidence-backed recommendations.
  • The strategic thinking, autonomy and adaptability to solve ambiguous problems, anticipate challenges and drive improvements beyond your immediate area of responsibility.

    • The Interview Process:

    1st: Initial Chat with Talent Partner (45 mins via Zoom)

    2nd: Interview with our team, Head of SEO and Senior SEO Manager (1 hour video via Zoom)

    3rd: Take home task - you will be given 3 days to complete the task and present it back to the team, Head of SEO and Chief Gaming Officer (1hour 30min video via Zoom)

title: Associate Director,  People Strategy & Execution
description:
Associate Director, People Strategy & Execution

About us:

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

Role Purpose

Reporting to the Group Chief People Officer and sitting on the People Leadership Team, the Associate Director, People Strategy & Execution plays a central role in shaping how the function operates and delivers.

They turn ClearBank’s People strategy into a focused plan and drive delivery through the People Leadership Team and programme owners. They connect priorities, programmes, budgets and governance - creating clarity, strengthening accountability and ensuring decisions lead to action and measurable outcomes. The role gives a clear view of progress, risks and investment choices, while coordinating high-quality reporting for Group ExCo, Board and TopCo.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role with broad exposure across ClearBank. When priorities stall or complex challenges arise, they step in to unblock progress, bring structure and pace, and lead critical programmes that matter to the business

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the People strategy and roadmap, partnering with the Group Chief People Officer and People Leadership Team to translate business priorities into clear outcomes, choices and plans.

  • Drive execution of the People roadmap through People leaders and programme owners, maintaining oversight of progress, outcomes, risks and dependencies; providing constructive challenge; resolving cross-functional blockers; and escalating issues and decisions to keep delivery on track.

  • Lead executive and Board reporting, producing clear, commercially focused insight and recommendations for Group ExCo, Board, investors and other senior forums.

  • Lead selected high-priority People initiatives, bringing structure, pace and stakeholder alignment to complex work requiring additional focus or acceleration.

  • Own People Team operations and governance, running effective forums, agendas, decisions, actions and escalations, and ensuring clear ownership and follow-through.

  • Own the People budget and Finance partnership, overseeing planning, forecasting, expenditure and investment choices to align resources with priorities and optimise costs.

  • Build portfolio and programme capability across the People function, putting in place proportionate standards, tools and ways of working that improve delivery, alongside clear management information on outcomes, costs, risks, dependencies, capacity and decisions required.

  • Improve how the People function operates, using clearer standards, simpler processes, data, digital tools and AI to strengthen consistency, insight and effectiveness.

What success looks like in the role:

  • The People strategy is clearly articulated, understood and translated into a prioritised roadmap with

  • ClearBank’s People strategy is translated into action and delivers measurable outcomes.

  • The Group Chief People Officer has a clear, reliable view of what is being delivered, by when, and where progress is at risk.

  • The People Leadership Team is aligned around the roadmap, decisions, ownership and delivery expectations.

  • Capacity constraints and competing demands are visible early, with clear recommendations on priorities, sequencing and trade-offs.

  • Issues and dependencies are surfaced and resolved quickly, keeping critical work on track.

  • The People function operates effectively and consistently, with proportionate governance, clear accountability and strong follow-through.

  • The People function is represented credibly and commercially through high-quality reporting to Group ExCo, Board, investors and other senior forums.

Skills & Experience (must-have)

  • Significant experience translating functional or business strategy into prioritised roadmaps and measurable outcomes.

  • Strong programme or portfolio leadership experience, driving delivery through others using proportionate, adaptable approaches.

  • Experience building effective governance and operating rhythms across senior leadership teams and complex portfolios.

  • Excellent analytical, written and visual communication skills, turning complex information into concise, high-quality papers, presentations and recommendations for executive and Board audiences.

  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, including budget ownership, forecasting, resource planning and investment trade-offs.

  • Credibility and influence with senior leaders, with the judgement to challenge constructively, align stakeholders and embed decisions without formal authority.

  • A pragmatic, solutions-focused track record of simplifying complexity and improving execution, using proportionate standards, adaptable tools, data and AI to improve insight and delivery without unnecessary bureaucracy.

Nice-to-have

  • Working within, or in close partnership with, a People or HR function.

  • Experience in banking, fintech, financial services or another regulated environment.

  • Supporting Group ExCo, Board, or investor governance forums.

  • Experience operating across multiple countries, legal entities or a matrix organisational structure.

  • Familiarity with OKRs or comparable strategy execution methodologies.

Ways of Working & Culture

  • Build trust together: Own outcomes end to end, follow through on commitments and create transparency around progress, risks and decisions.

  • Care like we mean it: Consider the impact of strategic and operational decisions on colleagues, clients and the organisation, while providing direct and respectful challenge.

  • Grow with the challenge: Remain resilient in a fast-moving environment, simplify complexity and use feedback and evidence to continually improve plans and delivery.

  • Succeed as one: Engage stakeholders early, bring teams together around shared priorities and put organisation-wide outcomes ahead of functional boundaries.

  • Clear a bold new path: Challenge legacy approaches, convert ideas into practical action and build governance and delivery solutions that can scale.

If this sounds like you, then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply!

 

*Please note that we are not currently able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

Help shape the future of specialty insurance

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the Role

We are looking for a QA Engineer to join our growing Product QA function and take ownership of testing across Artificial's product portfolio and customer specifications. description:

Who you are

description:

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

The team:

The Comms team builds and manages the technology that enables Kraken to communicate with customers across multiple channels, including phone, email, live chat and physical post. The team is responsible for both the underlying systems and the product features that support these customer interactions.

A key area of the team is voice and telephony, where they build the technology used by energy and support specialists to speak with customers. This includes managing real-time calls, handling customers and specialists joining or leaving calls, responding to connection and network issues, and ensuring calls can be reliably maintained or recovered when problems occur.

Unlike more traditional transactional backend systems, much of the Comms technology is highly real-time and event-driven. The team works with event streams, queues and continuously changing system states to manage interactions as they happen.
The team also integrates with third-party communication providers, such as Twilio, which supports Kraken’s phone networks and email sending.
Overall, Comms sits at the intersection of engineering, product and customer operations, building the technology that enables Kraken’s customer-facing teams to communicate effectively and reliably with customers.

What you’ll do:

  • Build and maintain the real-time technology that enables Kraken’s customer communication channels, with a particular focus on voice and telephony.

  • Develop reliable, event-driven systems that handle continuously changing states and interactions in real time.

  • Work with event streams, queues and asynchronous processes to manage customer and energy specialist interactions.

  • Build product features and tooling used by Kraken’s energy and support specialists to communicate with customers.

  • Solve complex real-time challenges, such as customers or specialists joining and leaving calls, connection issues and dropped calls.

  • Integrate Kraken’s systems with third-party communication providers, including platforms such as Twilio.

  • Work closely with engineers, product teams and customer-facing teams to understand problems and build effective solutions.

  • Help shape the technical direction of the Comms team as it grows, contributing to how the team’s focus, systems and ways of working evolve.

  • Take ownership of projects and contribute to improving the reliability, scalability and overall experience of Kraken’s communication systems.

  • Develop towards a people leadership role as the Comms team continues to grow.

What you'll need:

We're looking for someone with a general interest in technology and problem-solving; someone diligent and thoughtful.

Experience with the following:

  • Python

  • HTTP and REST APIs

  • Celery and async processing

  • Postgres

  • AWS

  • Terraform, Packer, Consul

  • HTMX

  • React and Redux

  • Test Driven Development

  • Spec Driven Development

  • Domain driven design and modelling

  • Experience working with event-driven, realtime systems

  • Writing robust and fault-tolerant software

title: Lead Fraud & AML Ops
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Role context

Pennylane currently operates around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model with Swan and is applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences. As we prepare to onboard new customers under our own licensed entity from mid-2027, we are building our first line of defence across onboarding, transaction monitoring, fraud and risk operations.

As Transaction Monitoring & Fraud Operations Lead, you will be one of the first operational leaders in this greenfield setup. Reporting to the Head of FinCrime Operations, you will lead first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations across Pennylane’s payment activities within a single team. You will own first-line alert handling and fraud case management, with clear escalation paths to Compliance and Risk.

Your mission will be to build and launch Pennylane’s first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations, then scale the team and its workflows as volumes grow—while maintaining strong decision quality, auditability and customer protection.

This is a high-autonomy role with direct exposure to a strategic regulatory project and close collaboration with Product, Compliance and Risk. You will help shape how Pennylane protects the financial activity of French SMEs as it brings more of its regulated operations in-house.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for business customers, ensuring that alert triage, investigations, customer outreach and escalations are completed in line with policies set by Compliance and Risk and within agreed SLAs.

  • Translate AML/CFT and fraud policies into operational procedures, decision trees and analyst playbooks, and provide evidence-based recommendations on alert quality and operational bottlenecks.

  • Review complex or high-risk alerts within the first-line mandate, oversee post-onboarding fraud cases and ensure that escalations, customer complaints and law-enforcement requests are handled with complete, auditable records.

  • Implement the QA and reporting framework, monitor operational and risk indicators, and support Compliance during controls testing, audits and regulatory reviews.

  • Recruit, onboard and lead the transaction monitoring and fraud analyst team, combining hands-on support with effective coaching and a culture of rigour, accountability and continuous learning.

  • Establish the team’s performance and capacity framework, covering SLAs, productivity, quality, backlogs, false-positive rates and hiring needs.

  • Partner with Product and Tech to test and improve transaction-monitoring, fraud and back-office workflows, prioritising automation while identifying the controls and decisions that should remain manual.

First 6–12 months

  • Deliver approved operating procedures, analyst playbooks and escalation rules before go-live.

  • Establish a capacity and hiring plan based on observed alert volumes and handling times.

  • Validate that alert queues, evidence collection, account measures and second-line handovers work operationally before launch.

  • By go-live, have first-line monitoring operational for new customers, with trained coverage, agreed SLAs, documented QA controls and named escalation owners.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in transaction monitoring, fraud or broader financial-crime operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including ownership of operational performance and complex case decisions.

  • Proven experience leading and developing an operational team responsible for alert queues or investigations, combining effective coaching with a hands-on player-coach approach when needed.

  • Strong understanding of first-line alert handling: triage, investigation, typology, escalation, and the difference between a fraud case and an AML case.

  • Good working knowledge of French and European AML/CFT expectations, including ACPR and TRACFIN requirements, and experience translating policy into SOPs, decision trees and analyst guidance.

  • Experience working with Product or Tech on workflow or tooling changes.

  • Sound judgement on what to automate, what to sample and what to escalate.

  • Ability to use operational metrics to manage quality, backlogs and capacity.

  • Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions under pressure and communicate complex cases clearly to operational and compliance stakeholders.

  • Comfort building operations in a greenfield environment where volumes are still uncertain and tooling is evolving.

  • Exposure to ACPR expectations, a licensing programme, a BaaS migration or law-enforcement requests would be an advantage.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Why join

  • Build first-line transaction monitoring and fraud operations for a new regulated entity from the ground up.

  • Shape the operating model before launch, rather than inheriting fixed processes and tooling.

  • Take ownership of a critical domain with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer protection and responsible growth.

  • Work closely with Operations, Compliance, Risk, Product and Tech on a strategic company project.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Lucie (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager

3. Case Study with Laurent and Léa (1h)

4. Last round with Stanislas and Felix (45 min)

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

title: Lead Credit Ops
description:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1200 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 500,000 TPE/PME et plus de 7000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Role context

Pennylane currently serves around 50,000 business accounts through a BaaS model and distributes short-term financing to a subset of those customers through specialised financing partners. As Financial Services becomes a larger part of Pennylane's strategy, we are applying for Établissement de paiement and Société de financement licences.

Our ambition is to start onboarding new customers under our own licensed entity by early 2027 and to scale our own financing activity. We will outsource part of the technology stack—including the origination platform, disbursement and repayment orchestration, and the collections engine. Your focus will be on applying the credit policy, running controls and turning that policy into day-to-day operations, in close collaboration with our Product and Business teams.

As Credit Operations Lead, you will build and launch the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s own-book financing activity. Reporting to the Managing Director, you will translate Risk’s credit policy into executable decisions, controlled workflows and auditable outcomes.

You will initially remain hands-on across origination, manual reviews, exception handling and portfolio monitoring. As volumes grow, you will scale the operating model, tooling and team in close collaboration with Risk, Product and our financing partner.

This is a high-autonomy, greenfield role at the heart of Pennylane’s future licensed operations.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end execution of credit origination, including manual reviews, decisions within the delegated first-line mandate, exception handling and escalation to Risk. Ensure that outcomes meet agreed SLAs and are supported by a complete audit trail.

  • Build the credit operating model, including procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, first-line controls, operational KPIs and escalation paths.

  • Own first-line operational monitoring of the active book, including repayment incidents, early-warning signals and the follow-up actions required by the credit policy.

  • Build the operational relationship with the financing partner, with clear responsibilities, service levels and escalation processes for servicing, disbursement and collection incidents.

  • Provide Risk with structured feedback on policy effectiveness, operational impact and emerging portfolio signals. Risk remains accountable for risk appetite, policy approval and independent oversight.

  • Partner with Product, Tech, Risk and Data to design origination workflows, analyst tools and scoring processes, translate operational needs into product requirements, and determine what to automate or retain for human review.

  • Remain hands-on during the launch phase, then recruit and lead the first credit analysts as volumes grow, establishing clear quality standards and a culture of rigour, accountability and customer clarity.

First 6–12 months

  • Before the first own-book exposure, deliver an approved end-to-end operating model covering procedures, decision trees, delegated authorities, evidence requirements and escalation paths to Risk.

  • Ensure that the origination workflow is operationally ready for launch by testing the main decision paths and failure scenarios with Product and Tech.

  • Establish the initial management framework, including SLAs, quality controls, operational KPIs, portfolio-monitoring indicators and reporting to the second-line Risk function.

  • Ensure that every credit decision can be reconstructed from the underlying data, evidence, applicable policy and recorded approvals.

  • Define the initial capacity model, team coverage and hiring plan based on expected volumes, handling times and observed performance.

  • By go-live, have trained operational coverage, named escalation owners and documented procedures for manual reviews, exceptions and partner incidents.

What we’re looking for

  • Significant experience in credit or underwriting operations within a regulated financial-services environment, including manual reviews, delegated decisions, exceptions and audit trails.

  • Experience managing operational quality, SLAs and capacity, with direct team leadership or a strong player-coach track record.

  • Strong understanding of first-line credit operations and the respective responsibilities of Operations and Risk.

  • Experience collaborating with Product or Tech teams on workflows, tooling and automation.

  • Ability to use operational and portfolio indicators to identify early-warning signals, manage performance and plan capacity.

  • Sound judgement on what to automate, what requires human review and when a case should be escalated.

  • Ability to make structured, well-documented decisions and communicate them clearly to customers, partners and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience with SME financing products, such as invoice financing or short-term working-capital facilities, would be a strong advantage.

Languages, presence and location

  • Fluent French and English are mandatory.

  • Based in France, with a strong preference for Paris.

  • Regular on-site presence in Paris is expected. Partial remote is possible. This is not a fully remote role.

Why join

  • Build the first-line credit operations function for Pennylane’s future société de financement from the ground up.

  • Shape the operating model, tooling and team before the own-book financing activity reaches scale.

  • Take ownership of a critical function with a direct impact on go-live readiness, customer experience and responsible growth.

  • Work closely with Risk, Product, Tech and our financing partner on a strategic company project.

  • Join a high-autonomy role with compensation that includes equity and reflects the level of responsibility.

Recruitment Process

1. Interview with Simon (30-45 min), Senior Recruiter

2. Interview with Maxime (1h), General Manager

3. Case Study with Laurent and Hippolyte (1h)

4. Team fit with two interviewers (30 min)

title: Backend & Applied AI Engineer
description:
🏨 The Company

Resilience Care, a leading player in remote medical monitoring and a partner in clinical research, is a French company founded in 2021 with a single mission: to provide better care.

Our company offers remote monitoring solutions in oncology, gastroenterology and psychiatry, based on the collection of ePROs combined with AI technologies. These solutions rely on a monitoring platform for healthcare professionals—enabling the early detection of side effects for continuous and proactive care—and a mobile app for patients, empowering them to measure and manage their symptoms using tailored resources.

Our solutions optimise patient care, continuously enrich our understanding of patients throughout their healthcare journey and accelerate clinical research through the collection, structuring and in-depth analysis of real-world data.

📝 Your Role

In a nutshell

You will join our engineering team as a Backend & Applied AI Engineer. Your role will focus primarily on a product used to structure real-world clinical data: developing and maintaining product services and APIs, improving performance and architecture, and strengthening production reliability.

You will also contribute to the delivery of AI-enabled features through code review and backend integration. In the short and medium term, the role is expected to be approximately 75% backend and 25% Applied AI. This split may evolve with team and product needs, without a predefined trajectory.

Your impact

  • Become progressively autonomous on the product backend during your first six months.

  • Reduce production blind spots by improving incident detection and follow-through.

  • Evolve the architecture to better support concurrency, parallelism and processing volumes.

  • Help the team deliver AI components that are reliable, performant and properly integrated into the product.

Your day-to-day work

  • Develop and maintain backend services and APIs in Python.

  • Work with the rest of the team, to deliver product changes end to end.

  • Measure and improve processing time, scalability and backend architecture.

  • Strengthen testing, CI/CD, observability and production reliability.

  • Collaborate with, the Applied AI Engineer, particularly on pull-request reviews and the backend integration of AI-enabled features.

✨ Your Team

You will work closely with:

  • Ivan Panico — Lead ML Engineer and your manager, who will support your ramp-up and major architectural decisions.

  • Tom — Applied AI Engineer, who owns the main Applied AI topics and partners with you on product integration.

  • Armand — Full Stack Developer, your main partner for designing and delivering product features end to end.

The team is mainly based in Paris and works remotely from France.

👤 Candidate Profile

⚙️ You are the right person if you know how to

  • Develop backend services in Python.

  • Design and evolve APIs.

  • Work with databases and data-processing workflows.

  • Use Docker, Git and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Understand latency, throughput, concurrency, parallelism and resource-consumption challenges.

  • Integrate an AI model or LLM API into a product, even through an initial hands-on experience.

🙂 You are the right person if you have

  • Open and direct communication.

  • An analytical mindset and the habit of testing your assumptions.

  • A collaborative approach across backend, frontend, product and applied AI.

  • The drive to learn quickly while asking for support at the right time.

  • Care for code quality and the operational consequences of technical choices.

📃 You are the right person if you have already

  • Built up to two years of professional experience, through employment or significant projects in Python backend development.

  • Developed and deployed at least one service or API.

  • Used a database in a real application.

  • Worked with Docker and a continuous-integration workflow.

  • Worked in both French and English, with a minimum B2 level in each language.

It is a plus if you have worked on processing-intensive systems, NLP/LLM pipelines, healthcare data or a production SaaS product.

💛 Why join us?

  • Build a product that puts data and AI at the service of care and clinical research.

  • Progressively take real backend ownership with support suited to an early-career role.

  • Work on concrete performance, architecture and production-reliability challenges.

  • Collaborate daily with frontend and Applied AI engineers.

  • Join a team that works remotely from France while maintaining regular links with Paris.

🤝 Recruitment Process

  1. Screening with Elena — 15 minutes. Motivation, role alignment, prerequisites and a brief English check.

  2. Manager fit with Ivan — 30 minutes. Role alignment, prerequisites.

  3. Technical interview with Ivan and Tom — 90 minutes for the candidate. You will have 30 minutes to work independently on a technical problem, followed by a 60-minute discussion of your approach, choices and trade-offs.

  4. Product collaboration interview with Jullian & Adil — 30 minutes

  5. Culture fit with Elena — 30 minutes.

title: Technical Implementation Manager / Chef.fe de Projet Déploiement Technique
description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour.

Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, deux choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer.

Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

🧩 Notre équipe Customer Operations

Chez Lifen, nous déployons nos solutions dans les hôpitaux de toute la France pour améliorer le quotidien des soignants et la qualité des soins.

L'équipe Customer Operations est le pont entre nos produits et les établissements de santé. Elle accompagne chaque hôpital dans l'implémentation de nos solutions : Lifen Documents & Lifen Intégration.

Notre équipe est composée de Project Managers et d'Operations Managers, tous pilotés par Loïc, notre Lead Customer Operations.

Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un profil à la croisée de la technique et de la gestion de projet : une personne capable de piloter un déploiement client de bout en bout, mais aussi de prendre en main les aspects techniques de l'intégration de nos solutions.

Si tu aimes autant comprendre comment fonctionnent les systèmes informatiques que coordonner les parties prenantes d'un projet, ce poste devrait te plaire !

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

En tant que Technical Implementation Manager, tu seras responsable de la mise en œuvre technique de nos solutions dans les établissements de santé, depuis le cadrage initial jusqu'à leur mise en production.

Ton rôle ? Faire en sorte que nos solutions s'intègrent correctement dans les systèmes d'information hospitaliers, tout en garantissant le bon déroulement des déploiements.

Concrètement, tu seras amené(e) à :

🔧 Piloter et réaliser les déploiements techniques

  • Configurer et déployer nos applications dans les environnements informatiques de nos clients.

  • Mettre en place et configurer les flux d'interopérabilité entre nos solutions et les systèmes d'information hospitaliers (notamment HL7).

  • Travailler avec les équipes IT des établissements sur les prérequis techniques : serveurs Windows, réseau, connectivité, VPN, SFTP, certificats et sécurité.

  • Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes techniques rencontrés lors des installations et des mises en production.

📋 Gérer tes projets d'implémentation de bout en bout

  • Organiser et animer les réunions de cadrage technique avec les établissements de santé.

  • Identifier les besoins, les contraintes et les prérequis techniques nécessaires au déploiement.

  • Coordonner les différents interlocuteurs (DSI, équipes techniques hospitalières, chefs de projet, équipes internes Lifen) pour assurer la bonne avancée des projets.

  • Suivre les différentes étapes du déploiement, anticiper les risques, lever les blocages et garantir la qualité des mises en production.

🔍 Garantir le bon fonctionnement de nos solutions

  • Réaliser les tests techniques et fonctionnels avec les clients afin de valider le bon fonctionnement de nos solutions de bout en bout.

  • Analyser les incidents et identifier leur origine (configuration, connectivité, flux, application...).

  • Assurer le support technique de niveau 2 en collaboration avec les équipes Support, Produit et R&D.

  • Surveiller les flux et les certificats pour anticiper les dysfonctionnements.

🤝 Être un interlocuteur technique de confiance pour nos clients

  • Échanger directement avec les équipes IT des hôpitaux pour résoudre les problématiques d'intégration.

  • Savoir expliquer des sujets techniques à des interlocuteurs moins techniques.

  • Comprendre les contraintes du terrain pour proposer des solutions adaptées, fiables et pérennes.

🚀 Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de nos déploiements

  • Documenter les configurations, les procédures et les problématiques rencontrées.

  • Identifier des opportunités pour standardiser, automatiser et fiabiliser nos déploiements.

  • Faire remonter les retours terrain aux équipes Produit et R&D pour contribuer à l'évolution de nos solutions.

  • Développer progressivement une expertise sur l'ensemble de nos produits.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Nous recherchons avant tout un profil technique qui aime gérer des projets, résoudre des problèmes concrets et travailler directement avec les clients.

🖥️ De solides bases techniques

Tu as une expérience pratique dans le déploiement, l'intégration ou l'administration de solutions logicielles et tu es à l'aise avec plusieurs des environnements et technologies suivants :

  • Systèmes : environnements Windows Server, administration système, GPO, installation et configuration d'applications.

  • Réseaux et connectivité : TCP/IP, VPN, SFTP, certificats et notions de sécurité informatique.

  • Intégration applicative : compréhension des échanges de données entre applications, des flux et des problématiques d'interopérabilité.

  • Diagnostic technique : capacité à analyser des logs, identifier l'origine d'un incident et conduire sa résolution.

Tu n'as pas besoin d'être expert(e) sur chacune de ces technologies, mais tu dois avoir suffisamment de bagage technique pour être autonome face aux problématiques d'un déploiement.

📋 Une expérience en gestion de projet technique

Tu as déjà coordonné des déploiements ou des projets d'intégration de logiciels chez des clients, en collaboration avec plusieurs interlocuteurs techniques et métiers.

Tu sais organiser un projet, suivre ses étapes, anticiper les risques et faire avancer les sujets jusqu'à leur résolution.

🤝 Une vraie aisance dans la relation client

Tu es capable d'échanger aussi bien avec un administrateur système ou un responsable IT qu'avec un chef de projet ou un utilisateur métier.

Tu sais vulgariser les sujets techniques, poser les bonnes questions et construire une relation de confiance avec tes interlocuteurs.

🛠️ Un état d'esprit orienté résolution de problèmes

Tu aimes comprendre comment les choses fonctionnent, investiguer lorsqu'un problème survient et trouver des solutions concrètes.

Tu es autonome, rigoureux(se), proactif(ve) et tu n'hésites pas à mettre les mains dans le cambouis plutôt que de simplement coordonner les actions des autres.

🏥 Une connaissance du secteur de la santé est un plus

Une expérience dans un établissement de santé, chez un éditeur de logiciels de santé ou dans l'intégration de systèmes d'information hospitaliers sera particulièrement appréciée.

Une connaissance des standards d'interopérabilité en santé, notamment HL7, est également un vrai atout.

Mais ce n'est pas indispensable : si tu disposes d'un solide socle technique et d'une expérience en déploiement logiciel, nous pourrons t'accompagner dans la découverte des spécificités du secteur hospitalier.

💎 Nos avantages

  • Package entre 40-47K€

  • Mode de travail : Commuter (3 jours/semaine au bureau)

  • Une carte Swile avec 9 €/jour (50 % Lifen)

  • Une mutuelle santé incluant médecine alternative et soutien en santé mentale (55 % Lifen)

title: First RevOps
description:
At Parallel, we build AI agents to help healthcare facilities automate their administrative processes and unlock additional revenue, starting with medical coding.


Today, up to 25% of healthcare spending is lost in manual, repetitive administrative work. Legacy software hasn’t helped, it’s made things slower, more complex, and more frustrating for care teams.

We believe AI agents can change that. Our technology combines Large Language Models with system-level automation to handle real work inside existing hospital tools. No integrations, no disruption.

Our first agent automates coding workflows and frees up time for medical staff to focus on patients.

We launched in 2024, are backed by top investors (Index, Frst, Y Combinator, Hexa, Kima Ventures, Better Angle), and we’re just getting started.

 

The future of healthcare isn’t just digital — it’s automated. Come help us build it !

Context

Our coding agent is live in 70 hospitals across France. In March, we raised $20M from Index Ventures to push it further and build what comes next: billing, admissions, patient records.

The next six months are going to move fast. We'll double to +60 people, open Germany, and triple the size of our Revenue team. Today, too much of how we run the company still depends on manual work and tools that don't talk to each other.

Nobody owns this problem yet, it will be yours.

Your mission

Make sure Parallel can double without drowning in manual work.

Attio, our CRM, will be your main tool, and you'll run it end to end. You'll also sit with each team, see what they still do by hand, and automate it yourself. On top of that, you'll work on Sales, Marketing and Finance Ops topics, like billing, cash tracking and commissions.

You'll report to Clem, our Ops Lead, and work every day with the founders and the go-to-market teams. You build things, you don't write decks about them. There's no team to manage at first, but the function is yours to shape, and we assume it will grow.

What you'll do

Own Attio, end to end

  • Administer and configure Attio: data model, pipelines, fields, views, access rights and workflows

  • Enrich our CRM with data valuable for Sales, Ops and Finance teams, so that it can be the source of truth while scaling

  • Connect Attio to the rest of our stack so processes run without manual steps

  • Support users and turn their pain points into better configurations

Automate our internal work, with AI where it makes sense

  • Map repetitive tasks across Sales, Marketing, Ops and Finance, and prioritize them by impact and effort

  • Build automations, integrations and AI use cases yourself, with no-code or low-code tools, and APIs when needed

  • Pick a simple rule or AI depending on the need, test on real cases, and keep a human in the loop when it matters

  • Protect sensitive data, control access, and measure time saved, errors and costs

Make Sales and Ops steering reliable

  • Help define the priority metrics and agree on shared definitions

  • Run the analyses, SQL queries and dashboards yourself

  • Automate data collection and updates to kill manual reporting

Build processes that hold as we double

  • Document the rules, owners, limits of AI use and what to do when something breaks

  • Structure the handoffs between teams, train users and check real adoption in the field

Outcomes

You ship from week one: automations are expected in your first month, not in six.

Month 1: diagnose and ship a first win

  • You run Attio autonomously, have audited its configuration and data, and shipped the first improvements teams feel

  • A prioritized list of automation and AI opportunities, and a 90-day plan validated with Clem

  • Your first automation is live, tested with its users, with a baseline measured to track the gain

Month 2: deploy and measure

  • Several automations are used by the teams, with time saved and output quality tracked on real cases

  • Priority metrics are live and tested with the teams

Month 3: stabilize and drive adoption

  • Several automations run in production, used regularly, with error monitoring and a clear maintenance owner

  • Attio and our data are reliable enough for the priority processes, and shared metrics are used to make decisions

  • Users are trained, and your 6-month extension plan is validated with Clem

Month 6: scale what works

  • The solutions that work are extended, documented and monitored

  • The key handoffs between teams are structured and adopted, keeping pace as we grow to around 60 people and open Germany

You are

The non-negotiable

  • You have run a CRM yourself, not just used it. You have administered, configured and optimized one personally: data model, pipelines, permissions, workflows, integrations. Attio experience is a plus; if you come from another CRM, you can show you will master Attio fast. Strong automation or AI skills won't make up for this one

Also essential

  • 3-5 years of RevOps, SalesOps or BizOps experience in a B2B startup, with business automations you built and shipped yourself

  • Real use of AI applied to internal work, and the judgment to know when a simple rule does the job better

  • At ease with data: you write SQL, run your own analyses and build dashboards; you ship a working v1 fast, then improve it

  • Autonomous and pragmatic: you don't wait for a detailed spec, you go after the high-impact problems and deliver simple, usable solutions

  • Rigorous: you check your work, set up controls and document so processes are reproducible

  • You explain technical topics simply to business teams, and get them to agree on rules and actually adopt them

Nice to have

  • A solid understanding of how a SaaS business works, from sales cycle to operations to billing

And you share our values

  • Play to Win: you set ambitious, measurable goals and own the result

  • High Trust, High Standards: you keep your commitments, raise risks early and hold a high quality bar

  • Low Ego, Hands-On: you take feedback, change course when facts say so, and do the unglamorous work yourself

  • Win as One Team: you put the collective goal ahead of your own scope

  • Don't Take Yourself Too Seriously: you own your mistakes and keep perspective when things get tense

Hiring process

  1. First call with Wallerand: our values, your background, and a first look at your CRM and automation experience

  2. Interview with Clem, Ops Lead: your future manager, deep dive into how you build and run a CRM and your automations

  3. Case study at our Paris office with Paul (CEO) and Clem: you structure and configure a CRM, then automate a process, from framing to a working prototype

  4. Founder interview with Paul

  5. Reference checks, with your consent

  6. Offer

Why should you join us?

  • AI with real-world impact. Our agents free hospital teams from paperwork, in a system where 70% of French hospitals are in deficit

  • A function to build from scratch. You are our first RevOps: the stack, the processes and how we use AI internally are yours to design

  • The right moment. A $20M Series A closed in March 2026, the team doubling to around 60 people, Germany opening, and everything still to build

  • An AI-native company that practices what it sells. We automate hospitals; you get to automate Parallel

  • Top-tier backers and founders. Index Ventures, Y Combinator, Hexa, the CEO of Mistral AI; founders from Meta, McKinsey and Hublo

  • Direct line to the founders. You work daily with Paul and the founding team, and your work shapes how the company scales

  • Room to grow. The role starts hands-on, with the prospect of building a team as the function grows

  • Competitive package. A competitive salary and equity (BSPCE), so you share in what you help build

 
 
 

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you're drawn to what we're building but don't meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet 100% of the criteria. If that's you, please don't let that hold you back. We'd love to receive your application.

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

As Procurement Manager, you will lead procurement, material planning and supply readiness to support our production schedules as we scale. You will own the operating mechanisms that turn demand into executable material plans, including Clear to Build (CTB) analysis, MRP execution and purchase order management. Leading a team of Buyers and Material Planners, you will work closely with Strategic Sourcing, Planning, Engineering, Quality, Finance and our suppliers to remove material constraints before they impact manufacturing.

  • Hold suppliers accountable for delivery performance, and drive recovery plans when commitments are at risk.

  • Represent material readiness in production, S&OP, shortage and operational review meetings.

  • Monitor and report key indicators on supplier performance, material availability and supply risks.

  • Resolve downstream issues with receiving, finance and accounting teams.

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Supply Chain or a related discipline.

  • Experience: 5+ years of supply chain experience in progressive roles, ideally in a manufacturing environment.

  • Proven Leadership: 2+ years managing or leading procurement, planning or materials teams.

  • Technical Expertise: Strong practical knowledge of MRP logic, BOM driven material planning, inventory management and production supply.

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces.
